citations.quote: Student groups and youth organizations assemble at the Edsa Shrine in Quezon City on Sunday, Sept. 20, 2026, during the “Walk for Truth and Justice.”

MANILA — Groups gathered at the EDSA Shrine in Quezon City on Sunday, September 20, to call for accountability for alleged corruption, demand greater transparency in the use of public funds, and push for the passage of an anti-political dynasty law.

The gathering, dubbed the “Walk for Truth and Justice,” began at La Salle Green Hills in Mandaluyong City and proceeded to the EDSA Shrine, where a program featuring speeches, solidarity messages and symbolic actions was held.
The activity came a day before the anniversary of the 2025 “Trillion-Peso March” and coincided with the 54th commemoration of the declaration of Martial Law.
The groups marched from De La Salle Greenhills to the EDSA Shrine a day before the first anniversary of last year’s Trillion Peso March and the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law.
